items.en_title: Guaratuba (PR) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #2 - 1002
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Guaratuba (PR) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento); proposals close Nov 27, 14:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
